entities.summary: Matthew Todd Steigenga is an American former professional basketball player. He was a 6'7", 220-40 lbs. small forward who most notably played a part of one season with the Chicago Bulls and a season in the Liga ACB. He is currently a broadcaster for Michigan State basketball games.
